_source: Liang, Eberhardt, Chen, arXiv:2504.08887: best published n per (k,d), from Table I, using the Appendix-E grafted value where one is published (grafted=true). This is the hardest fair bar: our codes are ungrafted, so beating a grafted entry is a strict win. For ungrafted baselines (grafted=false), a grafted paper value could be a few qubits lower, so a small margin there is not yet a definitive record.
